ideas.title: Minnesota Medicaid fraud: A growing concern
ideas.description: Investigate the growing concern of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota, including the recent case of a woman accused of using $600K in Medicaid funds for personal expenses.
questions: What is the extent of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?
ideas.insight: This story would investigate the growing concern of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota and potential solutions to prevent it.

ideas.title: Figure Lending Corp data breach: What happened?
ideas.description: Investigate the data breach of nearly 1 million user records at Figure Lending Corp, including what happened and how it can be prevented.
questions: How can similar breaches be prevented?
ideas.insight: This story would investigate the data breach at Figure Lending Corp and potential solutions to prevent similar breaches.
